_comment: OPT-IN example: smoke eval when a prompt file is edited. Copy the 'hooks' block into the target app's .claude/settings.json (NOT the plugin's) and adjust the 'if' path globs to where that app keeps prompts. Note the schema rules: 'if' lives on each command object (not the matcher entry) and holds exactly ONE permission rule — hence one handler per tool. The command targets <state_location>/scripts/smoke.sh, which is NOT created automatically: copy the plugin's docs/smoke.sh.example there, review it, and make it executable BEFORE wiring this hook - otherwise every matching edit fails with 'no such file'. Deliberately not shipped active: it spends tokens on matching edits; the example script debounces (skips if a smoke run finished <10 min ago).
